## Changes

- Describe the most important implementation change.

# example: cargo test --workspace

## Compatibility and release notes

Call out changes to the CLI, configuration, report schemas, Node API, Vite plugin,

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the reason they are unnecessary is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Generated files and release artifacts are unchanged unless intentionally updated.
